rationale: The stock is trading at the absolute top of today's range (100th percentile) after a 6.69% gap-up on strong earnings, with the last several 1-minute candles showing stalling price action and declining volume — classic exhaustion at a high. A long here risks buying the peak of a post-earnings gap with no room above, while a short against a strong fundamental catalyst (16.4% EPS beat, Zacks #1 rank) in a high-relative-volume session carries significant squeeze risk. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.49%, VIXY +9.60%), but MEOH is clearly decoupled from that today, making directional edge on either side too uncertain to justify a position.
